name: a wireframe brain grows into a solid faceted mark
looks: A handful of points on a dark field connect into a growing wireframe, line by line, until it traces a brain shape in full. Small triangular faces then light up one by one with flat warm colour, in no fixed order, turning the wireframe into a solid, glass-faceted object as a soft glow pulses behind it.
build: Precomputed low-poly mesh; edges stroke on in a seeded order; each face fades/scales in once its three vertices connect, seeded per-face stagger; a soft radial glow behind the mesh pulses gently throughout, same bloom as cinematic-atmosphere-hold's pinned flare.
sound: A faint high shimmer per connecting node, a soft glassy tick per face landing, building to a held chord as it completes.
prompt: On a dark field, grow a wireframe mesh line by line until it traces a recognisable mark's silhouette, then light its triangular faces one by one with flat colour in no fixed order, turning the skeleton into a solid, faceted object. Hold on the finished mark glowing softly before cutting away.
